settings.title: A highly controlled clean environment at each cage level

settings.editor: It’s portable, ergonomic, and easy to configure top-of-the-line ventilated rat housing system designed to house Innovive disposable IVC cages. The rack is powered by patented transversal airflow and delivers dual HEPA-filtered air into each recyclable cage. Controlled airflow allows  positive and negative modes of operation. It comes with a dynamic digital controller and provides a high-quality environment for your animals.

settings.title: Innorack Tall IVC Rat XL Features

icon_list.text:
Dynamic Digital Controller
  • • Dynamically maintains settings on both supply and exhaust blowers.
  • • Quick-look color display for easy status monitoring.

Easy Cleaning and Maintenance
  • • Continuous shelf design and smooth beveled surface allow for easy cleaning.
  • • Quick-disconnect blowers.
  • • Autoclavable Innorack available upon request.

Ergonomic Design
  • • Lightweight rack & blowers.
  • • Full cage visibility.

Low-Vibration Rack Operations
  • • A low-vibration ventilation system creates a stress-free animal environment, contributing to animal welfare.
